title: Election Metadata
description: Schema for optional metadata.json files. Core fields are implementation-neutral. Additional producer-specific fields are optional extensions that consumers can ignore.

generated.description: Date this metadata document was generated.

electionId.description: Optional election identifier for linking metadata to a specific election payload.

source.description: Optional source provenance supplied by the publisher.

kind.description: Optional source type label, such as url or file.

run.description: Optional producer/runtime details. Not required for data consumers.
